name: Stone Slide
hook: Slide it, then sweep like mad. Closest to the button scores.
how: Two teams take turns sliding stones down the ice at the target. Drag back to aim and set the weight, let go, then hold to sweep: it glides further and curls less. Four stones a team each end, three ends; your stones nearest the button score.
controls: Drag back and let go to throw, hold to sweep (mouse or finger); or arrow keys, Enter to throw, Space to sweep, C to change the curl
uses: Most match wins, shown on the results card.
The host's browser slides every stone and counts each end; if it leaves, the next player takes over mid-slide.
Bots throw and sweep on both teams until friends join.
Everyone sees each stone slide, the brooms sweep and the hits, all at once.
